solution.title: Copilot Agent Governance & Operating Model (Declarative Agents — Build, Approve, Share, Retire)

products.name: Copilot Agent Governance & Operating Model (Declarative Agents — Build, Approve, Share, Retire) — Commercial
products.short_description: Your users can now build their own AI agents. This is the operating model that governs them — ownership, an approval gate before business use, a sharing policy with review, and real retirement.
products.description:
Your users can now build AI agents in minutes. This is the operating model that keeps them owned, approved, and safe.

Inside Microsoft 365 Copilot, a business user can use Agent Builder to create a declarative agent, point it at SharePoint sites and Teams chats for knowledge, and share it with a colleague, a team, or the entire organisation — no code, and in most tenants no visibility for IT or Security. Copilot Studio agents already pass an admin approval gate; an Agent Builder agent shared with “Anyone in your organization” can reach the whole tenant with no approval at all. The result is a quiet build-up of ownerless agents (the maker left), unreviewed agents (shared wider than anyone assessed), and shadow agents (running with no registry entry). This solution closes that gap with a governance operating model — the org-policy layer for business-process agents.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested operating model as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a novice administrator can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell and every governance artefact pre-named.

  • Simpler — thirteen exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths (the Copilot Control System agent controls, the Agent Registry, the org-catalog approval gate); every role, group, list, and policy is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open consulting meter; a comparable governance engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable across every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with eight explicit PASS/FAIL governance gates that prove the model actually holds before you expand tenant-wide.

What's inside

  • Four-role accountability model (Agent Owner, Business Sponsor, Data & Security Reviewer, Agent Admin) with a full RACI and escalation rules
  • Intake & approval gate plus a standing Agent Review Board — closing the org-wide-sharing gap
  • Standards, sharing policy & periodic access review — no more silent org-wide shares
  • Lifecycle & retirement — the block-then-delete discipline that makes decommission safe and evidenced
  • The exact admin-center enforcement — Copilot Control System agent access & sharing controls, Agent Registry block / reassign / publish — verified against Microsoft Learn on the build date
  • Plugs into your existing Purview DLP, oversharing remediation, and the Entra/Defender “Agents at risk” signals without re-teaching them

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project, on unlimited devices.

The bottom line

Within two board cycles you move from an unknown, ungoverned agent estate to a measured one: every business agent owned, sensitive agents reviewed, org-wide shares approved, ownerless agents reassigned or retired, and a monthly scorecard that proves it. Identical process for Commercial and US Government tenants; portal and feature differences are documented inline.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF & Word) — the complete, click-by-click operating model: solution overview, requirements, thirteen-step implementation, testing & validation gates, troubleshooting, best practices, and executive summary.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 read-only, cloud-aware (Global / USGov / USGovDoD) Microsoft Graph scripts:
    • AGBGOV-Discovery.ps1 — Governance baseline of declarative agents, owners & sharing posture (READ-ONLY; Graph with CSV-export fallback)
    • AGBGOV-Validation.ps1 — Test each agent against the seven governance gates, PASS/FAIL (READ-ONLY)
    • AGBGOV-Report.ps1 — Trendable governance scorecard (READ-ONLY)
    • AGBGOV-Export-ApprovalEvidence.ps1 — Assemble an audit-ready approval evidence pack (READ-ONLY)
    • AGBGOV-Review-SharedAgents.ps1 — Flag org-wide / large-group / ownerless agents for access review (READ-ONLY)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
